definitions.explanation: food that has just been boiled and is still hot

examples.japanese: {茹|ゆ}で{立|た}ての{卵|たまご}は{熱|あつ}い。
examples.english: A freshly boiled egg is hot.

examples.japanese: {茹|ゆ}で{立|た}ての{蕎麦|そば}をすすった。
examples.english: I slurped up freshly boiled soba noodles.

examples.japanese: {茹|ゆ}で{立|た}てのとうもろこしに{塩|しお}をかけて{食|た}べた。
examples.english: I sprinkled salt on freshly boiled corn and ate it.

notes:
COMPOUND:
{茹|ゆ}でる (to boil) + {立|た}て (just done)

PATTERN:
The ~{立|た}て pattern indicates something freshly done:
- {揚|あ}げ{立|た}て - freshly fried
- {焼|や}き{立|た}て - freshly baked
- {出来立|できた}て - freshly made
- {採|と}れ{立|た}て - freshly picked

COMMON FOODS:
- {茹|ゆ}で{立|た}ての{麺|めん} - freshly boiled noodles
- {茹|ゆ}で{立|た}ての{枝豆|えだまめ} - freshly boiled edamame
- {茹|ゆ}で{立|た}ての{卵|たまご} - freshly boiled egg
